snippet.title: Fading Echo Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/2467880

A new trailer brought us into the striking cartoon world of Fading Echo, a brawler RPG where you manipulate the elements to take out your enemies and save the world from a spreading corruption. It's coming to PC on July 21, and consoles later this year.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
